name: event-map
title: Event Map
description: A map for logging events at places: tools to drop a pin or draw a circle or an area, a form for the event's title, type and notes, a list of saved events and a marker for each one, with details and Remove. Built on MapLibre with Terra Draw for drawing; the default dark street map is OpenFreeMap (free, no key), and a blank map or any MapLibre style can be passed instead. Takes the event types, optional starting events, and onEventsChange and onCreate callbacks.

meta.use_when: People mark where something happened or will happen (a point, a radius or a drawn part of a town or village) and attach details to it
